title: App-to-pipeline contract: functions

branch.description: Branch the deploy was built from, captured at build time

commitRef.description: Short git SHA of the deploy, captured at build time

paymentsMode.description: From the placeholder payment key's prefix (sk_test_ or sk_live_); the key itself is never returned

deployContext.description: Netlify's deploy context, from context.deploy.context at runtime

description: GET /api/health, called by smoke.yml after every Deploy Preview, staging and production deploy. Answers 200 with this body, Content-Type application/json and Cache-Control no-store, and never a key or a stack trace. Answers 500 with { error, correlationId } when the placeholder payment key is missing or unrecognised.
